[IRET.18.2.1] **`logical: false` overlay — the TMS table is not
allocated.** When the DSC loader configures an engine for a
`logical: false` program, the TMS table is not initialised and its entry
array is left NULL. No memory is allocated for TMS entries,
`withdraw_scratch`, or `heap_ids` overflow buffers. The RT table
pre-sizing step that would normally allocate the TMS scratch is
skipped, and the TMS capacity is left zero.

This is the mechanism by which [LNOG.4.1]'s allocation guarantee
holds: the guarantee — that a `logical: false` program allocates
nothing for truth maintenance — is observable and stays in [LNOG.4.1];
the field names by which this engine achieves it are implementation.
